summary: Kyle Walker, 26, fell 60 feet while free-soloing the Second Flatiron; his foot slipped on a lichen-covered section. Found by a hiker about an hour later, going in and out of consciousness; taken by rescuers to hospital with broken wrists, eight ribs, a broken pelvis and a punctured lung. Released from Boulder Community Health Foothills Hospital.
notes: Fall captured on his chest-mounted GoPro. Responding agency not named in the source. Fills thin year 2019 for Boulder.
